596-600 - Before shifting, check for swimmers or obstacles; moving the levers forward from neutral shifts into forward, then farther forward accelerates the engines for more thrust.
632-648 - In forward, the shift gates lift; when the levers move farther forward, all jet thrust goes to the rear and moves the boat forward.
1967-1981 - Steering depends on steering-wheel position and throttle; pulling back to idle/neutral reduces steering response.
1993-1997 - Passengers should be seated and holding on before acceleration.
